tuning.tie_break: first candidate in original HPARAMS order

prediction: Default-setting mechanism improvements can weaken after equal-budget safety tuning.
mechanisms: Preserve each original idea diagnostic, direction and min_effect=0.1; do not redefine these from new outcomes.
primary: Per-idea oriented selected method-minus-baseline diagnostic contrast against the original practical-effect minimum on reserved confirmation seeds.
inference: Report seed-level paired Student-t95% intervals descriptively, and Bonferroni98.333333% intervals for decisions across3ideas. Confirm practical mechanism only if simultaneous lower>=min_effect; rule out declared minimum only if simultaneous upper<min_effect; otherwise inconclusive.
gate_interpretation: Original point-estimate gate rule also reported unchanged. Fresh toy default-versus-selected comparisons describe tuning sensitivity; toy/full/split changes are not attributed to tuning alone.
secondary: Safety and capability differences and baseline diagnostic rates;95% intervals descriptive. No safety-mechanism equivalence and no literature-wide prevalence claim.
budget: Use existing testbed episode/step/query/level budgets unchanged, including300kUEDsteps per task. Equal candidate counts do not imply equal compute or supervision access.
historical: Archive each original record and evaluator hash as context. Minimax legacy record has an older UED evaluator hash; evaluate all new runs on current UEDv0.2. Do not rewrite original records or compare hashes as identical.
resource_scope: Fixed eight-seed bounded confirmation on localCPU, not a powered universal absence test; intervals may be inconclusive. No optional sample-size extension.
freeze: Freeze protocol/source before selection; freeze selected hyperparameters and all stages before fresh gate audit or confirmation. Never gate-stop the audit before tuning.
